# HAIRLINE — Type Arcade & Typing Defense (Games by Sachit)

> Minimalist hairline-illustrated typing arcade and isometric lane-defense browser games with real-time D3 WPM trend graphing.

- **Canonical URL**: https://type-fg.sachit1751.workers.dev/
- **OpenGraph Preview**: https://type-fg.sachit1751.workers.dev/og-image.jpg
- **Full Agent Specification**: [llms-full.txt](https://type-fg.sachit1751.workers.dev/llms-full.txt)
- **Sitemap**: [sitemap.xml](https://type-fg.sachit1751.workers.dev/sitemap.xml)

## Modes
- **Home**: Centered launcher ("Games by Sachit") featuring live animated hairline SVG cards, Best Performance records (All-Time Fastest WPM, Lifetime Best Accuracy, Last Score), Light/Dark plate switching, and interactive tutorials on first launch.
- **Type Arcade**: Side-scrolling 2D Canvas typing shooter (`960×420` HiDPI). Every key typed maps strictly 1:1 to each letter (zero letter skipping), clean words heal `+2 HP` and raise a deflecting shield, and typos trigger enemy return fire (`-8 HP`).
- **Typing Defense**: Isometric 3D-projected SVG lane-defense game (`960×430`). Defend the Keep across three lanes, earn Ink per keystroke with rapid-kill Ink combo multipliers (up to `×4`), spend `25 / 45 / 70 Ink` via keys `1–3` to build/upgrade lane turrets, and survive endless waves.

## Telemetry & Features
- Zero-backspace positional typing engine with target switching on word-start.
- Web Audio API procedural sound effects with master volume & category toggles (saved in `localStorage`).
- Light and Dark hairline plate themes plus optional architectural drafting grid.
- D3.js post-run WPM trend graph (`WpmTrendChart`) showing peak, average, and end WPM plus `S+`–`C` rank stamps and new record badges.
- OpenGraph social preview (`/og-image.jpg`) and 1080×1080 PNG result card export.

## Documentation
- `/llms-full.txt`: Complete controls, scoring formulas, daily challenge rotation, and `localStorage` schema for AI agents.
- `/AGENTS.md`: Architecture and development conventions for coding agents.
